title: Analyst | SAP MM IS-Retail | Mumbai | SAP | DSA Consumer & TMT
description:
**Analyst \| SAP MM IS\-Retail \| Mumbai \| SAP \| DSA Consumer \& TMT**
  

• **Job requisition ID** : 112938
  

• **Location**: Mumbai
  

• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP


**The team**


Enterprise technology must do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long\-term growth. Learn more about ET\&P


**Your work profile**


* Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP MM and SAP IS\-Retail solutions that support retail merchandising, procurement, and supply chain operations.
* Configure and support core SAP MM processes, including Purchasing, Procurement\-to\-Pay (P2P), Inventory Management, Invoice Verification, Vendor Master Management, Material/Article Master Management, Physical Inventory, and Stock Transfer processes.
* Design and support SAP IS\-Retail functionalities, including Merchandise Management, Article Master, Assortment Management, Site Master Management, Store Replenishment, Retail Procurement, and Listing Procedures.
* Partner with business stakeholders to optimize retail operations, inventory management, store supply, and procurement processes.
* Participate in SAP implementation, rollout, enhancement, migration, and support projects across retail and merchandise management landscapes.
* Conduct Fit\-Gap analysis and recommend industry best practices to improve retail supply chain efficiency and process effectiveness.
* Prepare functional specifications and collaborate with ABAP teams for reports, interfaces, forms, workflows, and custom developments.
* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, and business validation activities.
* Support data migration, master data governance, validation, reconciliation, and cutover activities during project implementations.
* Ensure seamless integration with SAP SD, SAP FICO, SAP WM/EWM, and other related SAP modules.
* Provide post\-go\-live support, production support, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement recommendations.
* Maintain functional documentation, process flows, training materials, and knowledge repositories.

**Key Requirements**


* 4\-6 years of hands\-on SAP MM consulting experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in SAP IS\-Retail projects or retail industry implementations.
* Strong expertise in Purchasing, Procurement\-to\-Pay (P2P), Inventory Management, Invoice Verification, Vendor Management, Material/Article Master Management, Release Strategies, Physical Inventory, and Stock Transfer processes.
* Good understanding of retail business processes including Merchandise Procurement, Merchandise Management, Assortment Management, Store Operations, Replenishment Planning, Inventory Control, and Retail Supply Chain Management.
* Experience with SAP MM integration with SAP SD, SAP FICO, and SAP WM/EWM modules.
* Experience in implementation, rollout, enhancement, AMS, or production support engagements.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Retail for Merchandise Management is preferred.
* Exposure to SAP CAR (Customer Activity Repository), SAP Fiori, SAP Ariba Integration, SAP EWM, and SAP MDG will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of omnichannel retail, e\-commerce operations, demand replenishment, and retail merchandising processes is desirable.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem\-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience in retail transformation initiatives and large\-scale retail operations is highly desirable.

**Education**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* SAP MM or SAP S/4HANA Sourcing \& Procurement certification is preferred.
* SAP Retail or Merchandise Management certification will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Retail, FMCG, Consumer Goods, Grocery, Fashion \& Apparel, E\-commerce, or related industries is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Agile, Scrum, SAP Activate methodologies, and global rollout programs will be an added advantage.
